title: Murciavania: bringing Murcian folklore into an AI-assisted Godot 4 Metroidvania
author: PuzzleheadedAd5521
selftext:
Hi, I’m Manuel, the developer behind Murciavania. It is a released Godot 4 Metroidvania inspired by the folklore and geography of Murcia, Spain.



In development, I used generative AI assistance for visual assets and music, as well as code, room design, writing and translations. The visual material was reviewed, adapted and integrated into the game rather than generated live for the player. Editorial review and integration testing were part of the process. Sound effects are synthesized in code.



The finished game does not generate content during play or connect to external AI services. I disclose the development use of AI on the Steam page.



For others working on AI-assisted games: how do you keep environments and characters visually consistent across a large interconnected world? I’m interested in the review and integration side of the workflow, beyond generating individual assets.



Commercial disclosure: this is my game and it is sold on Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5294670/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5294670/)



This post was prepared with AI assistance.
